versions.content: AUTOSAR communication shall support a signal gateway Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR communication shall support a signal gateway which receives signals and sends them out again unchanged Rationale: The receiver of a s ignal may reside on a different bus which is connected via a gateway ECU.
